purpose: Freeze a candidate-neutral estimator interface over the exact HOLD-LC-001 event bytes while preserving the existing T-054 forward method and T-059 inverse method.

exact_scope.finite_scope: The nine products and the estimator design are finite, versioned and retrospective; no continuum or infinite-volume operation is declared.
exact_scope.cache_policy: Use the local gitignored HOLD-LC-001 cache only for reacquisition and byte checks; the tracked contract carries locators and parent hashes, not raw bytes.
forbidden_actions: Do not fit or rank a microscopic candidate.
Do not replace a source likelihood with an independent Gaussian summary.
Do not use a retrospective target as prospective validation.
Do not substitute an observation anchor for the Reading-H physical-empty branch.
Do not alter the T-054 owner order or the T-059 estimand and promotion rules.

estimand_contract.observable_role: A candidate-neutral temporal interface for later model comparison; not yet a predictive distribution.

candidate_neutral_preprocessing.rule: Every preprocessing, compression and event-selection operation must be fixed before candidate maps are evaluated and may not depend on candidate labels, candidate parameters or candidate residuals.
required_fields: time standard and leap-second or GPS conversion version
GW strain calibration version and valid time range
GBM onset search and background windows
sample cadence, interpolation and missing-data rule
geocenter transformation and detector timing convention
unresolved_fields: time standard source and exact conversion table

likelihood.forbidden_substitute: Do not treat 1.74 +/- 0.05 seconds as an independent Gaussian observation.

nuisance.allowed_interim_form: The existing set-valued envelope may remain a feasibility boundary only.

four_stage_map.input: Frozen event bytes plus the candidate-neutral preprocessing interface.
four_stage_map.output: Finite detector-level timing features and their source-owned uncertainty object.
fixed_requirements: volume and boundary convention where applicable
time standard, calibration, detector selection and compression

four_stage_map.input: A finite regulated law from F_reg.
four_stage_map.output: A limit law only after uniform control is proved.
required_proof: common core or common estimator domain
declared cutoff, volume, exhaustion and limit order
four_stage_map.current_boundary: HOLD-LC-001 is retrospective finite data; no continuum or infinite-limit claim is available.

four_stage_map.output: An effective QFT/YM/GR parameter or correlator map.
required_owner: Ward or Slavnov-Taylor conditions where applicable
four_stage_map.current_boundary: The event products do not by themselves identify a microscopic dynamics or physical theory identity.

four_stage_map.input: An effective prediction plus declared nuisance parameters.
four_stage_map.output: A raw-data predictive distribution or candidate-neutral estimand prediction.
four_stage_map.current_boundary: No score, ranking, candidate selection or prospective credit is permitted.

static_dynamic_quotient.relation: M_a ~_static M_b iff their declared static functional and admitted static observables agree after the declared gauge, field-redefinition and regulator equivalences.
static_dynamic_quotient.test_rule: Evaluate the frozen temporal estimand on the quotient only after a source-owned dynamics and all four map stages are admitted.
outcomes: If the temporal observable separates members, retain the surviving dynamic equivalence classes.
If it is invariant over a class, report NONIDENTIFIABLE rather than selecting a representative.
If calibration, nuisance or regulator perturbations reverse the result, report UNSTABLE_FINITE_ONLY.

ownership_split.separation_rule: A proof-owner choice cannot fill a missing physical-owner field. If physical predictions depend on the proof realization, version it as a separate candidate and do not merge the results.

checks_to_run: Parent manifest hashes and product IDs match exactly.
All unresolved estimator fields remain explicit and no score field is populated.
Candidate labels and candidate parameters are absent from preprocessing inputs.
Retrospective role and empty prospective lock remain unchanged.
Existing T-054/T-059 method and owner pointers remain unchanged.
The four-stage missing-stage rule is mechanically respected.

acceptance_for_v0_2: A source-owned or independently reproducible time-standard and calibration contract is hash-pinned.
All timing, background, detector and energy windows are frozen before target use.
A joint likelihood or covariance with component and shared-source terms is supplied.
An intrinsic-emission nuisance law or explicitly declared set-valued scoring rule is preregistered.
A complete candidate-neutral F_reg implementation is independently reproduced.
At least one admitted candidate fills F_lim, F_eff and F_obs with its own owner hashes.
The prospective holdout is sealed before any candidate score or map tuning.

adversarial_review.objection: The published central value and uncertainty could be silently treated as a Gaussian timing likelihood.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the contract marks both likelihood and covariance NOT_ADMITTED and forbids the substitute.

adversarial_review.objection: Hash-pinned response, trigger and strain products might be mistaken for a complete calibration and geocenter covariance.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: calibration, time standard, windows and shared covariance remain SOURCE_OWNER_REQUIRED.

adversarial_review.objection: The estimator interface could be tuned against the disclosed event and later called a prediction.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: HOLD-LC-001 is RETROSPECTIVE, PROS-LOCK-001 remains empty, and target-dependent preprocessing is forbidden.

adversarial_review.objection: The selected H1/L1 and N0/B0 subset could be presented as a complete multi-detector analysis.
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED-FOR-SCOPE: the exact scope labels the subset as finite intake and leaves source completeness pending.

adversarial_review.objection: A finite timing feature could be used to choose a dynamics from a static-equivalence class without an owner generator.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: R-193/R-200 quotient rule and the physical-owner split prohibit static-to-dynamic inference.

adversarial_review.objection: Adding the estimator contract could silently replace the established T-054 or T-059 methods.
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: all method, owner-order and parked-loop preservation flags are explicit and true.

assumptions: The byte-freeze manifest remains the authoritative locator and hash record for the nine event products.
A candidate-neutral temporal interface can be specified before a candidate-specific forward map is admitted.
The reported source summary is retained for provenance but is not promoted to a likelihood.
The existing T-059 anti-leakage and prospective-lock rules remain controlling.
A design-only contract is a continuity advance, not a scientific result.
missing_assumptions: Source-owned time standard, calibration and geocenter conversion with uncertainty.
Frozen timing, background, detector and energy windows.
Joint likelihood or covariance including shared-source and calibration terms.
Intrinsic-emission nuisance law or preregistered set-valued scoring rule.
A sealed unused prospective holdout and immutable scorer.
evidence_level: T0 exact-input lineage plus candidate-neutral estimator design; no statistical or physical test
next_action: Obtain the missing source-owner calibration, time-standard, window, covariance or likelihood and nuisance specifications; independently reproduce the candidate-neutral F_reg implementation only after those fields are frozen, while continuing unchanged T-054 owner intake.
non_claims: This contract does not admit a likelihood, covariance, nuisance probability law, candidate, score or prospective prediction.
It does not identify a microscopic dynamics or distinguish members of a static-equivalence class.
It does not prove Lorentz invariance, a causal cone, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, Pre-A, C6, A13, Sector-A, continuum, physical vacuum, cosmic origin, a theory of everything or a mass gap.
It does not perform the Reading-H physical-empty test and cannot replace an owner-approved common functional or empty branch.
It preserves rather than replaces the established T-054 forward and T-059 observation-first inverse methods.
